Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, itertools, random
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
base=bytearray(z.read(z.namelist()[1]))
for _ in range(200):
    x=bytearray(base)
    for _ in range(2):
        pos=random.randrange(len(x)); x[pos]=random.randrange(256)
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(x)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('hit',r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
        break
else:
    print('none')
